newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil worker kills three colleagues, then himself.
newsitem.headline: Brazil worker kills three colleagues, then himself.

text.p: An office worker shot dead three colleagues then turned the gun on himself on Wednesday at Sao Paulo's state sewer company, a spokesman said.

Marcelo Kenji Yoshino, 22, opened fire on a group of workers at the offices of Sabesp, killing three women and injuring two others, the spokesman said. There was no immediate word on the conditions of the injured.
"We don't know why this happened. We have never had a problem with this worker in the past," he said.
Yoshino killed a 53-year-old attorney and two legal aides, aged 42 and 26, before taking his own life, the spokesman said.

Yoshino, who joined the company as an office boy and was recently promoted to the post of administrative assistant, was in frequent contact with his victims, but co-workers said they were at a loss to explain the tragedy.
